Fixer bug-2130 STOPPED before any edit (no claim, no commits; worktree clean at 474735dd24).
1) Condition (c) unmet: reader commit 3f7bcd28fd (TASK-1750 steps 1+2) is in NO tagged release. 'git tag --contains 3f7bcd28fd' = empty; latest release v0.15.0 (2026-09-12). Your 2026-10-18 ruling on BUG-2130 says the writer switch lands only after that release, and your later mail to agy1 says '#2735: holding on its release condition is correct'. This brief says writers record linux-starttime now, which is the same switch.
2) Duplicate work: PR-2735 (agy/bug-2130, OPEN, MERGEABLE) already implements the writer switch + scheme-aware readers + btime-shift tests, and has two rounds of review findings (/tmp literal, adopt-lease recycled-pid test, legacy lock-blocks test, worktree_gc owner_is_caller, leases lease_minted_by_returned_phase_child, ...).
3) The only release-independent piece, 'legacy rfc3339 mismatch resolves to alive', is Option C, which you rejected on 2026-10-14.
Options: (A) keep holding; operator cuts a release, then agy finishes PR-2735 rework. (B) you waive (c) on BUG-2130, and I take over PR-2735's rework instead of opening a duplicate PR. (C) you reverse the Option-C rejection; that is a new STRICT design. Reply with A/B/C.
subject: BLOCKED: BUG-2130 brief conflicts with standing condition (c) + duplicates PR-2735
